Ever wondered how computers sort things? 🤔 Let's dive into the simplest sorting algorithm: Bubble Sort! ✨ We'll visualize it step-by-step, showing you how those 'bubbles' rise to the top. Perfect for beginners and a fun refresher! 🚀

In this video, you'll learn:
✅ What Bubble Sort is
✅ How it works visually
✅ Its time complexity (and why it's not always the best!) 😅
✅ Practical applications (where it *might* still be useful!)
